hooks.command: if [[ "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" =~ (rm\s+-rf|git\s+push\s+--force|DROP\s+TABLE) ]]; then echo 'BLOCKED: Destructive command detected' >&2 && exit 2; fi
if printf '%s' "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS" | rg -q '\.(env|pem|key|json)$'; then echo 'WARNING: Attempting to edit potential secret files' >&2; fi
if printf '%s' "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS" | rg -q '\.py$'; then black $CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS || true; isort $CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS || true; ruff check $CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS || true; fi
if printf '%s' "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS" | rg -q '\.ipynb$'; then jupyter nbconvert --ClearOutputPreprocessor.enabled=True --inplace $CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS || true; fi
if printf '%s' "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS" | rg -q 'tests/.*\.py$|test_.*\.py$'; then pytest -q --maxfail=1 || true; fi
